name: app-banking-user-research-charts-slide
title: Banking User Research Charts
whatItIs: A tall grey slide with three survey questions each above a white card chart: a set of pink bars with percentages, a semicircular gauge in green, red and grey, and a rising staircase distribution, closed by a quote.
whatItMeans: Rounded white cards with muted red and green keep research light and readable. Each question is paired with the chart form that suits it.
techniques: Vary chart type per question (bars, gauge, stair steps)
Pale gradient bars instead of harsh fills
Question sits above its chart in lighter type
Cards staggered left and right for rhythm
Pull-quote at the end humanising the data

vocabulary.definition: A semicircular chart showing a value in a range.
Bars arranged as a descending or ascending staircase.
